entities.name: Mox Jasper
entities.description: Legendary mox jewel on Tarkir formed when the Dragonstorms imbued the land with dragonfire; it appears to draw mana from dragons.

entities.name: Dragonstorms
entities.description: Event that imbued Tarkir with the essence of dragonfire.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Plane where the Mox Jasper is found.

events.summary: The Mox Jasper formed on Tarkir after the Dragonstorms imbued the land with dragonfire.
events.quote: The Mox Jasper was formed on Tarkir after the Dragonstorms imbued the land itself with the essence of dragonfire.
